hero.caption:
Hong Kong - Kai Tak International (HKG / VHHH) [CLOSED]
Hong Kong, China  11.1993  

Picture taken some days after they took the plane out of the water! This plane had overrun the runway on November 4, 1993, when landing in bad weather during Tropical Storm Ira.
